lines.text: Did you learn how to use Light Up from\nProfessor Oak’s assistant, too?

Wha...?\c
You didn’t learn it...but [VAR PKNICK(0003)] did?!\c
That partner of yours really is
amazing, [VAR TRNAME(0000)]...
Hey, you know what? I actually know someplace\nwhere you might be able to use it!\c\nWant me to take you there?
All right! We’ll be there in no time.\nCome on!
So, just head east here from Cerulean City...

That’s this direction—got it?\c
Just keep going this way, and you’ll eventually
hit this cave system called the [VAR COLOR(0006)]Rock Tunnel[VAR COLOR(0000)].\c
I hear it’s pitch dark!
If you use Light Up, though, you don’t have to\nbe scared of the dark!\c\nSee you around!
Really? Well, OK...\c\nYou sure you’ll be all right?
Yeah, I want to go alone

OK!\c
Just in case, though, let me give you directions.
If you head east from [VAR COLOR(0006)]Cerulean City[VAR COLOR(0000)], you’ll reach
a place called the [VAR COLOR(0006)]Rock Tunnel[VAR COLOR(0000)]. It’s supposed
to be pitch dark in there.\c
Be careful!
